# dark-app-factory

Generate a working web application from a plain-text description. Runs locally on Ollama. No cloud required.

- **Ports**: dashboard 10738, MCP 10739, Vite dev 10740
- **Version**: 0.2.2-beta
- **Test status**: 135 pass, 3 e2e scaffold hang (need timeout) 
- **License**: MIT

## Quick Start

```powershell
just bootstrap   # uv sync --group dev
just serve       # backend on :10738 (uvicorn web.server:app)
just dev         # frontend on :10740 (Vite, proxies /api to :10738)
just test        # pytest (skips e2e scaffold)
just gates-green # ruff check + pytest + ruff format
```

## Architecture

```
vibe.md --> [FOREMAN] --> specs.md + scenarios.md
              |
              v
         [WORKER]
           Step 1  DTU starts on :8001
           Step 2  Stack profile from specs
           Step 3  File manifest planned
           Step 4  Specialist Council (19 specialists, parallel tiers)
           Step 5a App.tsx Reconciler (React only)
           Step 5b Deep-crawl (missing import resolution)
           Step 6  manifest.json + landing page
           Step 7  Judge: install deps, boot on assigned ports, execute scenarios
           Step 8  Output directory finalised
              |
              v
         output_XXX/
```

## Specialist Council (19 members)

| Specialist | Domain | Requires |
|------------|--------|----------|
| Professor | Skill context injection | -- |
| Registrar | package.json, requirements.txt, Dockerfile | -- |
| Nervos | WebSocket / messaging | -- |
| Plumber | Backend (Python/Node) | Professor |
| Sculptor | Frontend (React/HTMX) | Professor |
| Morpheus | Security, auth | Plumber |
| Raggy | RAG / vector search | Plumber |
| WebFinder | Web scraping | Plumber |
| Archivist | ePub/PDF parsing | Plumber |
| Maestro | Audio / music | Nervos |
| Auditor | Excel/Word, data validation | -- |
| Picasso | SVG, illustrations | -- |
| Shakespeare | Marketing copy | -- |
| Tesla | Robotics, IoT, ROS | Nervos |
| Amodei | AI/LLM integration | Plumber, Sculptor |
| Houdini | Animations, Three.js | Sculptor |
| Librarian | README, docs | Plumber |
| Propagandist | Marketing kit | Shakespeare, Librarian |
| Generalist | Catch-all | All above |

Tiers resolved from `requires` graph. Same-tier specialists run with `asyncio.gather`.

## App.tsx Reconciler (v1.8.0)

After all specialists finish, reads actual files in `src/pages/` and `src/components/`
then regenerates App.tsx to reference only real components. Fixes the #1 Vite startup
crash (import of non-existent pages).

## Digital Twin Universe (DTU)

Mock server on port 8001 that replaces external APIs during testing. 9 services:
Stripe, Auth, Email, SMS, Storage, Discord, Slack, Weather, Webhook. Service registry
at GET /dtu/services, request log at GET /dtu/log.

## Judge (verification)

1. Install phase: runs `bun install` / `pip install -r requirements.txt` in output dir
2. Boot phase: starts app on factory-assigned ports (not probed from common dev ports)
3. Scenario execution: Playwright/Rodney against the running app
4. Mechanical scoring: status code match, list response, error detection
5. Deterministic FAIL gate: if app never listened on its port, verdict is FAIL
6. Boot report includes install outcome, per-process exit codes, log excerpts

## Port Management (src/utils/ports.py)

Shared port allocation and process-tree kill. Replaces three divergent copies:
- `kill_ports()`: Stop-Process + taskkill on Windows, SIGTERM elsewhere
- `kill_pid_tree()`: taskkill /F /T on Windows, process-group kill elsewhere
- `find_free_ports()`: allocate N free ports from a range
- `KNOWN_FACTORY_PORTS`: [(3000, 3000), (5173, 5175), (8000, 8002), (8080, 8080), (10738, 10739)]

## MCP Tools (port 10739, path /mcp)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| factory_fleet(operation) | ping, web_health, web_status, dashboard_url, launch_dashboard, tail_log, read_settings |
| factory_run(vibe) | Start a generation run, returns run_id |
| factory_status(run_id) | Poll run status, log tail |
| factory_stop(run_id) | Cancel running build |
| factory_launch(output_dir) | Launch generated app in new console |
| factory_assess(output_dir) | Static analysis, Prefab UI card, score 0-100 |
| factory_outputs(limit) | List completed output directories |

## Web Dashboard API (port 10738)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| /api/v1/health | GET | {"status":"ok","server":"dark-app-factory","version":"2026.3"} |
| /api/status | GET | active_builds, last_verdict, settings_provider |
| /api/runs | GET | All build runs |
| /api/run/{id} | GET | Poll run status |
| /api/run | POST | Start a run |
| /api/run/{id}/stop | POST | Stop a run |
| /api/outputs | GET | List output directories |
| /api/outputs/launch | POST | Launch generated app |
| /api/settings | GET/PUT | Read/write settings |
| /api/help | GET | List help docs |
| /api/help/{id} | GET | Help doc content |
| /api/logs | GET | Log viewer |
| /api/logs/download | GET | Download log file |
| /api/models | GET | Auto-detect Ollama/LM Studio models |
| /api/specialists | GET | List specialist council |
| /api/progress | GET | Build progress state |
| /api/assess | GET/POST | Assessment CRUD (from MCP tool) |

## Frontend (web_sota/)

React 19 + Vite 6 + TailwindCSS 3 + Zustand + React Router. 8 pages:

| Route | Page | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| / | Dashboard | Hero, KPI cards, recent runs, outputs |
| /inbox | Inbox | Build notifications |
| /tools | Tools | MCP tool listing |
| /skills | Skills | Specialist council |
| /chat | Chat | LLM chat, 4 personalities, localStorage history |
| /settings | Settings | LLM provider detection, model selector |
| /help | Help | Documentation browser |
| /logs | Logs | Factory log viewer |

## Configuration (env vars)

### Models
| Var | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| FOREMAN_MODEL | llama3.1:latest | Planning model (called once per run) |
| FOREMAN_BASE_URL | http://localhost:11434/v1 | Foreman API base |
| FOREMAN_API_KEY | ollama | Foreman API key |
| WORKER_MODEL | qwen2.5-coder:latest | Code generation model |
| WORKER_BASE_URL | http://localhost:11434/v1 | Worker API base |
| WORKER_API_KEY | ollama | Worker API key |
| OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH | 65536 | Context window (minimum 64K) |

### Ports
| Var | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| FACTORY_PORT | 8001 | DTU mock server |
| DASHBOARD_PORT | 8002 | Legacy web dashboard |
| MCP_PORT | 10739 | MCP HTTP server |
| APP_PORT_START | 19300 | Generated-app port window start |
| APP_PORT_END | 19400 | Generated-app port window end |

### Boot / Install
| Var | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| SKIP_APP_INSTALL | false | Skip dependency install |
| APP_INSTALL_TIMEOUT | 600 | Seconds per install command |

### Generation
| Var | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| MAX_RETRIES | 3 | Per-specialist retry limit |
| MAX_CRAWL_DEPTH | 3 | Deep-crawl passes |
| JUDGE_PASS_THRESHOLD | 0.7 | Pass rate required |
| PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS | true | Headless browser mode |

## Current State (v0.2.1-beta)

### What works
- Full pipeline: foreman plan, worker build, judge verify
- 19 specialists with dependency-resolved parallel execution
- DTU with 9 mock services + audit log
- App.tsx reconciler (prevents missing-import crashes)
- Dependency install before judge boot
- Deterministic port allocation (no false-PASS from unrelated servers)
- Process-tree kill (no orphan leaks)
- SOTA web dashboard with 8 pages
- Chat with local LLM (Ollama/LM Studio), personalities, localStorage
- Session context injection (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, .claude-plugin/, .windsurfrules)
- CORS on both web and MCP endpoints (fleet standard)

### Known gaps
- e2e_scaffold tests are marked @pytest.mark.slow (require Ollama, 10+ min each). Run with `just test-e2e`.
- Active builds tracked in-memory only (survive restart via /api/runs)

## Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| factory.py | Pipeline orchestrator (async) |
| foreman.py | Planner: enrich, plan, research |
| worker.py | Execution engine: specialist council, validation |
| judge.py | Quality gate: install, boot, Playwright, verdict |
| run_manifest.py | Generated app boot orchestration |
| web/server.py | FastAPI dashboard backend |
| web_sota/src/ | React frontend (8 pages) |
| mcp-server/src/dark_app_factory_mcp/ | FastMCP tools |
| src/utils/ports.py | Port allocation, listener detection, process-tree kill |
| src/utils/logger.py | DarkLogger singleton |
| src/specialists/council.py | 19 specialist implementations |
| src/specialists/base.py | Abstract base class |
| dtu/main.py | Digital Twin Universe |
| reports/deep-assess-2026-07-29.md | Current deep assessment + fix plan |
